answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 7347 Country: India Title: I wanted to know about the things that invalidate nikah automatically.i.e, i have heard that if a married person does zinaah then his nikah becomes invalid with his life partner.so i wanted to know even the minutest things that invalidate a persons nikah.i want its complete details.its really imp .for me to know this thing is really imp.. please for god sake do reply. Question: salamun alaik I wanted to know about the things that invalidate nikah automatically.i.e, i have heard that if a married person does zinaah then his nikah becomes invalid with his life partner.so i wanted to know even the minutest things that invalidate a persons nikah.i want its complete details.its really imp .for me to know this thing is really imp.. please for god sake do reply. Answer ID: 7347 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1706/1463=/1429) Nikah is not invalidated itself by any act. Yes, if any Muslim (may Allah forbid) becomes apostate, then the nikah is nullified, or if he utters any word of kufr , then also nikah is nullified. Adultery does not make the nikah null and void. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
